Motif’s own code is MIT licensed (see LICENSE). Market items integrated from upstream projects keep their original license and copyright notices, which also appear in the header of every such file. Each upstream is pinned to the commit we reviewed.

We only integrate code whose license allows redistribution (MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, BSD, Zlib, Unlicense, CC0). Projects under Commons Clause, non-commercial, AGPL or no license are linked, never copied.
